title: AuthorOpenParams
description:
`author.open` params. Exactly one of `scope` or `fork` names the mode:
staging over an existing scope, or fork-scoped exploration.

branch.description:
Open against a named branch head instead of `main` (WS-3, ≥ contract
1.7.0). Requires `scope` (branch + fork is refused); defined only from
1.7.0 up — a schema violation below it.

fork.description: Open a fork-scoped workspace, named by its question.
